subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should persistent multi-agent workspace context remain in the Dashboard breadcrumb/header surface, or move to the no-breadcrumb app shell direction being explored in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017?
rationale: The requested behavior is still missing, but current main has refactored the UI structure and an open maintainer draft proposes deleting the same header surface, so automation cannot safely choose the final UI contract.

options.title: Refresh Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep the breadcrumb/header surface, rebase this PR onto the current UI structure, and close the linked issue only for the focused active-agent plus workspace slice.

options.title: Move Context Elsewhere
options.body: Use the no-breadcrumb app shell direction and require a replacement persistent workspace-context surface before closing the linked issue.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Pause this PR until switch feedback, quick-switching, and stronger live-target proof are included in one larger Dashboard context design.

recommendation.title: Refresh Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep the breadcrumb/header surface, rebase this PR onto the current UI structure, and close the linked issue only for the focused active-agent plus workspace slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open maintainer draft is the active competing header/topbar direction that must be reconciled with this PR.
